purpose: Teach: 宮内/市況/愛さ/べし/つた/こく/まぜ/混ざっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お味の濃くなった煮物、お客様に伝った、絶対お気に入りです。当社、宮内庁御用達を目指せ
lines.en: These richer-flavored simmered dishes—customers love them. We should aim to become a purveyor to the Imperial Household.
lines.style: Commanding but measured. Clipped phrasing. Low, steady delivery on the business logic. A man laying out vision with the confidence of someone who has already seen it work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市況は厳しいですが対応中です
lines.en: Yes. Market conditions are tough, but we're adapting.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Lean forward slightly in bearing. A beat of acknowledgment before the reassurance. Professional warmth, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、自分の仕事を愛さねば成果は出ない
lines.en: But employees won't deliver results unless they love their own work.
lines.style: Shift to teaching tone. Slower, weightier. Tap of conviction on 'love.' This isn't instruction—it's something he has learned. Eyes level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営者たるもの、決断力あるべしです
lines.en: Yes. And as leaders, we have to show decisiveness.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, but with a subtle correction underneath. Not passive. He's claiming his own ground here. Measured, not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧客の声を企画に活かすべし
lines.en: We need to take what our customers tell us and build it into our planning.
lines.style: Return to directive tone. Clear emphasis on 'customers' and 'build.' Composed. The voice of someone who knows listening is strategy, not softness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。我々、お客様の信頼に応えるべく日々こつこつと取り組んでおります
lines.en: Yes. We're working on it every day—answering their trust with steady, careful effort.
lines.style: Earnest and present. Slight lift at the beginning of 'every day'—pride in the work itself, not in the result. Warm but grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の色んな意見を、まぜながら新企画を作れ
lines.en: Mix different employee perspectives together and build something new from them.
lines.style: Sharp clarity on the opening. Emphasis on 'mix'—this is the key instruction. Confident, lean forward in intention. Finishing with finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い手法と新手法が混ざった戦略です
lines.en: Yes. Our strategy weaves the old methods with the new—they need each other.
lines.style: Closing statement. Slight settling into the idea as he speaks. Thoughtful pause before 'each other'—he's affirming something true. Quieter than the confirms before.
